ownerIntake.businessType: Industrial manufacturer, $120M revenue, flat growth, but selling top 3 customers at discount pricing
ownerIntake.stage: Trap: Customer concentration (top 3 = 45% revenue) masked by healthy gross margin numbers (top customers are lower-margin but not obviously so). Sales team optimizing for volume/top-customer relationships without measuring profitability per customer.
ownerIntake.ownerGoal: Must diagnose: is customer mix optimal, or is concentration in low-margin customers driving profitability issue?
